revision: the section pages read 14 Nov 2026 22:3x-22:5x +04 (SHA-256 of each page in section_info)
holder_unknown: not named in the section's table
holder_sources: the reference in the last column of the section's table, from its list of references
pending_queue: Packomania's list of pending requests (pending.html, dated 9 Nov 2026, read 14 Nov) holds thousands of unreviewed candidates, by section and range of N (for example 1,456 for the eight rectangles, 2,213 and 1,813 for csq, 587 and 17 for ssp); their values are not published, so a cell's best known value is the table's, and a candidate in the queue may already beat it
title: Circles of any radii in the unit square with the largest sum of radii

template.title: {n} circles of any radii in the unit square with the largest sum of radii (Packomania {section})
template.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles, each of any positive radius, in the unit square [0,1]^2 so that the sum of their radii is as large as possible.
template.submission: Text file: {n} lines, each the centre and the radius of one circle, x y r (decimal numbers separated by spaces or commas), in the square [0,1]^2; see checkers/pack_check.py, section {section}.

score: the sum of the radii (larger is better)
best_text: The best known sum of radii in Packomania's table is {best} ({holder}); a valid packing with a larger sum improves it.
open_rule: every N of the section csqv (complete up to N = 1999, and further N up to 10,000) whose value is not in bold (proven optimal), N >= 3
left_out: csqv: 0 proven, 2 small N (N = 1: 1/2; N = 2: 2 - sqrt 2, by the diagonal)
